execution_frontier.name: Inference-only module rollback diagnosis of protected R2 batch-64 checkpoint
execution_frontier.summary: Protected R2 trained 64/799 rows from the promoted R1 flow-restored hybrid with model_g.flow frozen and hash-stable. The batch-64 primary gate reproduced at 124/125: DWCACC-0021 ('ei') failed only the 0.08 s duration floor at 0.05805 s, with healthy RMS. Across five seeds the checkpoint has 121/125 rows passing all five; four rows are seed-sensitive (two duration failures, two low-level failures), versus 125/125 rows passing all five at the promoted source hybrid. Before any further training, selectively restore R2-updated inference-side modules from the promoted source to identify which module drift caused the robustness regression.

promoted_r1_hybrid.strengthened_gate: 125/125 on each of five deterministic schedules; 625/625 total

abort64_five_seed_diagnosis.interpretation: The primary duration miss can be removed by inference settings, but this does not justify changing the governed gate because the same checkpoint has low-level failures on other seeds. R2 has improved median output amplitude while reducing stochastic robustness relative to the promoted source.
